# The people behind fulfilmentcrowd 

Meet the team supporting ambitious brands with tech-first fulfilment

## Decades of industry experience, ready to support your brand 

 30+

## Investor-backed fulfilment, trusted by 250+ brands 

We help ambitious brands enter new markets and scale globally with ease. As a trusted fulfilment provider with over 30 years of experience, we deliver tailored DTC and B2B order fulfilment solutions designed to support fast, sustainable growth.

Backed by Palatine Private Equity, our mission is to become the global leader in fulfilment technology and solutions. With Palatine's investment, 17 warehouse locations and technology developed in-house, we're actively working towards our goal of being the number one fulfilment platform for omnichannel brands.

## Meet our operating board 

 

### Lee Thompson

Chief Executive Officer

 As Chief Executive Officer of fulfilmentcrowd, Lee drives our strategic ambition to set the global standard in omnichannel fulfilment solutions and technology. 

 

### Paul Taylor

Managing Director

 With over 20 years of experience in logistics and supply chain roles, Paul oversees our growth board, ensuring we continue to scale in a way that’s both efficient and aligned with the needs of our clients. 

 

### Jon Davies

Chief Financial Officer

 Jon supports many strategic and operational decisions within fulfilmentcrowd, as well as maintaining the financial reporting and control environment. 

 

### Lee Gregson

Chief Technology Officer

 Lee oversees our product and innovation teams, ensuring the fulfilmentcrowd platform is a best-in-class tool for global, omnichannel brands. 

## Learn about our growth board 

 

### Paul Taylor

Managing Director

 With over 20 years of experience in logistics and supply chain roles, Paul oversees our growth board, ensuring we continue to scale in a way that’s both efficient and aligned with the needs of our clients. 

 

### Katie Shepherd

Director of Marketing

 Katie stepped up to Director of Marketing after leading a pivotal, multi-territory GTM strategy for the business. She now focuses on continually strengthening how we show up in a competitive market. 

 

### Rachel Miller

Director of Finance

 Promoted internally to the role of Director of Finance, Rachel's responsibilities are centred around financial risk management and corporate compliance. 

 

### Ben Chicken

Director of Commercial

 After stepping up to the role of Director of Commercial, Ben now leads our data-led approach to decision-making across the business. 

 

### Matt Humphreys

Director of Sales

Following his promotion to Director of Sales, Matt leads our international new business acquisition strategy, helping to drive continued growth across new and existing markets.

 

### Austin Waddecar

Director of Product

 Austin oversees our product teams, ensuring that the fulfilmentcrowd platform continues to serve the ever-changing needs of global, omnichannel brands. 

 

### Neil Midgley

Director of Operations

 Neil arrived at fulfilmentcrowd in 2026 with more than 37 years of logistics and supply chain experience, now leading operational excellence across our global fulfilment network. 

 

### Shaun Cummins

Director of Information Systems

 Shaun has been a member of our leadership team for 26 years, now overs eeing a data-driven DevOps team focused on delivering actionable insights and operational efficiency. 

 

### Chris White

Director of Client Services

 As Director of Client Services, Chris leads our customer service operation and oversees commercial relationships with our global carrier partners. 

 

### Robin Gerrits

Managing Director, Fulfilment.nl

Robin joined fulfilmentcrowd following the acquisition of Fulfilment.nl – a business he founded – bringing more than 15 years of experience in eCommerce, fulfilment and business growth to lead our Benelux operations.

## Recognised for our impact in technology and fulfilment

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

### Our HQ

fulfilmentcrowd Ltd, Western Avenue, Matrix Park, Chorley, United Kingdom, PR7 7NB

### Customer support

Already a customer? Raise a ticket in the fulfilmentcrowd platform or speak to your account manager to request assistance.

### Contact sales

Looking for your next fulfilment partner? Reach out directly to our sales team by emailing sales@fulfilmentcrowd.com.

### Job openings

Interested in growing your career at a tech-first fulfilment company? Email us at marketing@fulfilmentcrowd.com to enquire about job opportunities.

### Media enquiries

For all media and press enquiries, please contact our marketing team via marketing@fulfilmentcrowd.com.

 Who is on the fulfilmentcrowd management team? 

 fulfilmentcrowd's management team brings together leaders from across fulfilment, logistics, technology, finance, sales, marketing and customer services. The business is led by an experienced operating board and growth board, combining decades of expertise to support the company's continued innovation and international growth. 

 What experience does the fulfilmentcrowd leadership team have? 

 The leadership team has extensive experience across eCommerce fulfilment, supply chain management, logistics, software development, finance and customer experience. Many team members have previously held senior positions at leading organisations including Wincanton, DHL Supply Chain, ASDA, Victorian Plumbing, EY, PwC, Hermes (Evri), Yodel and Arrow XL, bringing a broad range of commercial and operational expertise to the business. 

 How does the management team support customers? 

 While day-to-day fulfilment is delivered by dedicated operational and client service teams, the management team plays a key role in shaping the technology, infrastructure and customer experience behind every fulfilment solution. Their focus is on continually improving the platform, expanding the fulfilment network and helping customers scale successfully. 

 How does fulfilmentcrowd continue to innovate? 

 Innovation is driven by dedicated product, technology and information systems teams that continually develop new platform features, integrations and warehouse workflows. This ongoing investment helps fulfilmentcrowd improve automation, inventory management, fulfilment visibility and the overall customer experience as market requirements evolve. 

 Is fulfilmentcrowd led by fulfilment, technology or eCommerce experts? 

 It's a combination of all three. fulfilmentcrowd's leadership team combines decades of experience in fulfilment operations with specialists in software engineering, product development, finance, sales and eCommerce. This blend of expertise helps ensure the business continues to develop technology-led fulfilment solutions that support ambitious brands as they grow. 

 How long has fulfilmentcrowd been in business? 

 fulfilmentcrowd was founded in 1993, originally developing ERP software before expanding into technology-led fulfilment. Today, the business combines more than 30 years of industry experience with a global fulfilment network and proprietary platform, supporting ambitious eCommerce brands across multiple international markets. 

 How has fulfilmentcrowd evolved over the years? 

 Since its founding in 1993, fulfilmentcrowd has evolved from an ERP software business into a global fulfilment technology provider. Through continued investment in its proprietary platform, international warehouse network and leadership team, the business now supports B2B and direct-to-consumer fulfilment across the UK, Europe, the United States and Australia. 

## Ready to simplify omnichannel, global fulfilment?

About fulfilmentcrowd | What Makes Us, Us

# The fulfilment partner of choice for global, omnichannel brands 

Supporting worldwide business growth with tech-first fulfilment, backed by 30+ years of industry experience.

## To be the leading fulfilment platform for omnichannel brands 

### We are challengers

We push boundaries, think differently and embrace change. In a fast-moving industry, we continuously adapt, innovate and refine our approach to deliver smarter, more efficient fulfilment solutions.

### We are relentless

We work with passion, determination and a focus on results. Challenges drive us, opportunities excite us and we never settle for 'good enough'. We always strive to deliver the best for our customers.

### We are a team

Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. By working together internally, with customers and with partners, we create smarter to scale. Because we achieve more together than we ever could alone.

## Over three decades of building smarter tech and helping brands scale without limits 

1993

### Founded as Exact Abacus Ltd, we began our journey by providing ERP solutions, laying the groundwork for what was to come.

As the business evolved, future CTO Lee Gregson joined, bringing his expertise and innovative approach to the team. In 1998, Lee Thompson, now CEO, came on board – a key player in driving the company toward its future as a leader in fulfilment technology. 

2000

### In 2000, we took a bold step and launched a Unix-based ERP system as a hosted SaaS solution, an industry first.

This move positioned us as industry challengers that aimed to consistently push boundaries. In 2001, we added another first by launching Third Party Fulfilment as a value-added service, expanding our offerings and laying the groundwork for what the business eventually became. 

2005

### By 2005, our business growth demanded more space, leading us to a new 15,000 sqft warehouse and office complex at Matrix Park.

Not stopping there, in 2007, we launched a new ERP platform based on Microsoft technologies, making our solutions even more prepared for the next phase of our journey. 

2015

### In 2015, we launched a web-based interface that made managing operations easier than ever. 

The following year, we acquired a second, 11,000 sq ft warehouse at Matrix Park, increasing our capacity and setting the stage for more ambitious goals. Our expansion continued in 2017 when we signed our first network partner and opened the Martland Park centre, further extending our reach.

2019

### In 2019, we rebranded as fulfilmentcrowd Ltd, reflecting our growth in the fulfilment and logistics industry. 

I n 2020, our global expansion began, with new centres launched in France, Germany, the Netherlands and the USA. With BGF investing to accelerate our growth, 2021 marked the arrival of Paul Taylor as COO – now Managing Director – bringing even more industry expertise to drive us forward.

2022

### In 2022, we launched the Retailer App, designed to support omnichannel brands with managing their fulfilment in one place.

In 2023, we opened our largest centre to date (500,000 sqft) at Magna Park (UK), partnering with Iron Mountain. We continued to innovate in 2024 with the launch of Delivery IQ – addressing consumer parcel anxiety – and the Service App to improve in-centre operations. Later that year, we continued our growth with another centre in Dublin, Ireland. 

2025

### A significant year for the business, following investment from UK-based private equity firm Palatine.

Early in the year, we put a pin down under by opening a new fulfilment centre in Australia. Located in Kemps Creek, Sydney, the 20,000 sqft site offers brands the opportunity to serve customers in the APAC region. In June, investment from UK-based private equity firm Palatine sparked our next phase of growth, a landmark moment for our future aspirations as a company.

2026

### Our growth story continued into 2026 with the opening of three centres in the United States in partnership with Royal Fulfillment.

Located in New Jersey, Chicago and Los Angeles, our new US network provided custo m ers wit h coast-to-coast American fulfilment for the first time. Then, in May, we announced the acquisitio n of Dutch eCommerce logistics specialists Fulfilment.nl, further accelerating our growth and offering within the EU.

### With 17 fulfilment centres worldwide and an award-winning platform, we help omnichannel brands manage their global fulfilment in one place

We’ve got no intention of slowing down anytime soon, as we strive to become the world’s number one fulfilment platform for omnichannel brands. 

## Meet those responsible for driving our global growth 

### Lee Thompson

Chief Executive Officer

 

Appointed as CEO in 2022, Lee drives our strategic ambition to set the global standard in omnichannel fulfilment technology. 

A 25-year fulfilmentcrowd veteran, Lee is a champion of talent and progression, putting shared values of integrity, teamwork and professionalism at the heart of everything we do. 

 + - 

### Paul Taylor

Managing Director

 

Paul has over 20 years of experience in logistics, supply chain, retail and eCommerce fulfilment, and is responsible for both operations across our network and leading our growth board. 

Before joining fulfilmentcrowd, Paul was Operations Director for UK 3PL Wincanton, leading transport and warehouse activity for a multi-channel retailer with 700+ branches and a large, complex eCommerce proposition. Paul also has experience with ASDA, DHL Supply Chain and Phones4U in senior operational roles. 

 + - 

### Jon Davies

Chief Financial Officer

 

Jon joined fulfilmentcrowd in May 2023 from Victorian Plumbing, where he was Head of Commercial Finance. Having qualified as a chartered accountant with EY in 2012, he has subsequently gained over 10 years of experience working in a variety of commercial finance roles, predominantly in eCommerce businesses. 

 + - 

### Lee Gregson

Chief Technology Officer

 

Lee joined the business over 30 years ago in a programming role before becoming Managing Director in 2007. 

Now Chief Technology Officer, Lee leads our product and innovation teams. This group of software architects, UX specialists and programmers develop new functionalities for the fulfilmentcrowd platform, including order workflow automation, warehouse management, returns, supply chain and open integration. 

 + - 

### Katie Shepherd

Director of Marketing

 

Katie has over 10 years of experience spanning sales and marketing, cultivating a rich skill set encompassing design, development, branding and strategic thinking. Through her diverse experiences, Katie has proven herself as a versatile and innovative marketer, adapting strategies to meet evolving business needs. 

 + - 

### Neil Midgley

Director of Operations

 

Neil joined fulfilmentcrowd in 2026, bringing more than 37 years of experience across logistics, manufacturing and supply chain operations to the business. Throughout his career, he has led large-scale warehousing, distribution and transport operations for some of the UK's biggest retail, food and third-party logistics organisations, developing extensive expertise in complex fulfilment environments.

As Director of Operations, Neil oversees fulfilment operations across the business, drawing on decades of experience in continuous improvement and scalable logistics. A Fellow of the Chartered Institute of Logistics and Transport (FCILT), Neil combines deep industry knowledge with a practical, customer-focused approach to delivering high-performing fulfilment operations.

 + - 

### Rachel Miller

Director of Finance

 

Rachel qualified as a chartered accountant with PwC and gained valuable experience during her four years in the audit function at Mazars. She then transitioned to industry roles, spending the last six years in two PLC businesses where she led the reporting and control environment essential for AIM-listed companies. Most recently, Rachel served as Group Financial Controller at Victorian Plumbing plc. 

In her current role, Rachel oversees the daily operations of the finance team, ensuring that the financial reporting and control environment is robust and effective in supporting the company's sustainable growth. 

 + - 

### Ben Chicken

Director of Commercial

 

Ben joined fulfilmentcrowd as Head of Commercial Finance in 2024, bringing a wealth of experience from previous roles in large PLCs, including Pets at Home and Auto Trader, both FTSE constituents, as well as his most recent position at the AIM-listed SME Revolution Bars Group. Ben’s expertise lies in financial modelling, process automation and uncovering insights through data analysis. 

 + - 

### Matt Humphreys

Director of Sales

 

Matt has over 20 years of experience in the logistics, supply chain and warehousing industry, and joined fulfilmentcrowd in November 2022 to drive the development of our UK business, following a 13-year spell as a Director at Sphere Group. Matt leads our wider commercial team, supporting brands across the world with deploying bespoke fulfilment solutions. 

 + - 

### Austin Waddecar

Director of Product

 

Austin has over 15 years of experience in product management, design and software engineering. Since joining the company in 2013, he has occupied multiple leadership roles across web design, innovation and product development. 

Austin leads multiple product teams that deliver value daily for fulfilment partners, retailers and consumers. He’s won multiple personal and business innovation awards – including Lancashire Innovator of the Year – and has over 10 years of experience in helping eCommerce retailers succeed. 

 + - 

### Shaun Cummins

Director of Information Systems

 

Shaun has an extensive background in software engineering and has been a member of the fulfilmentcrowd leadership team for 25 years. He has led various key projects for the business, including developing a comprehensive data warehouse and deploying Power BI to serve mission-critical information to all stakeholders. 

 + - 

### Chris White

Director of Client Services

 

 + - 

### Robin Gerrits

Managing Director, Fulfilment.nl

 

Robin joined fulfilmentcrowd in 2026 following the acquisition of Fulfilment.nl, the business he founded and successfully grew into one of the Netherlands' most reputable fulfilment providers. With more than 15 years' experience in eCommerce, fulfilment and entrepreneurship, Robin built Fulfilment.nl on the values of exceptional customer service and operational excellence.

 + - 

## Recognised for our impact in technology and fulfilment

 

 

 

 

## The partner of choice for leading brands 

> “Having the data at the click of our fingers on the fulfilmentcrowd platform is already saving us hours of time.”

 Nick Marsden, Co-founder 

> “fulfilmentcrowd helped us establish a warehouse in Germany, as well as the UK, allowing us to service our EU customers more effectively – a key factor in choosing the right fulfilment partner.”

 Michael Boyle, Head of eCommerce & Digital Marketing 

> “fulfilmentcrowd has been a key player in supporting our direct-to-consumer growth in the UK. Their technology not only provides support for our promotional campaigns, but enables us to offer greater flexibility to our customers.”

 John Luck, Chief Marketing Officer 

 

> “Working with fulfilmentcrowd has allowed us to scale without compromising on the premium experience our customers expect. The way they’ve handled the intensity of our product launches has been critical to our growth over the last few years.”

 Caroline Duckett, Founder 

> “As we expanded into the US, fulfilmentcrowd was crucial in supporting our growth. Relocating stock into America cut shipping costs and transit times, while their returns management boosted order volume and reduced waste.”

 Jennifer Bailey, Founder 

 Who is fulfilmentcrowd? 

 fulfilmentcrowd is a global, tech-first fulfilment provider that helps brands manage B2B and direct-to-consumer fulfilment through one connected platform. With an international network of 17 warehouses and over 30 years of industry experience, fulfilmentcrowd supports businesses as they grow across new channels and global markets. 

 What makes fulfilmentcrowd different from other fulfilment providers? 

 fulfilmentcrowd combines global fulfilment services with an award-winning technology platform developed in-house. Rather than managing multiple providers, systems or warehouses, businesses can oversee inventory, orders, fulfilment and reporting through one platform designed to simplify growth. 

 How long has fulfilmentcrowd been established? 

 The business was founded in 1993, originally providing ERP software before expanding into third-party fulfilment. Today, fulfilmentcrowd has more than 30 years of experience supporting ambitious businesses with tech-first solutions. 

 Can fulfilmentcrowd support international growth? 

 Yes. fulfilmentcrowd operates a global fulfilment network with warehouse locations across the UK, Europe, the United States and Australia. Businesses can expand into new markets while continuing to manage fulfilment through the same platform, processes and support teams. 

 Does fulfilmentcrowd provide both fulfilment services and technology? 

 Yes. fulfilmentcrowd combines physical fulfilment with proprietary fulfilment technology. The platform connects inventory, orders, integrations, reporting, returns and warehouse operations into one system, giving businesses greater visibility and control as they scale. 

 What types of eCommerce businesses does fulfilmentcrowd support? 

 fulfilmentcrowd works with ambitious eCommerce brands of varying sizes, supporting both direct-to-consumer (DTC) and B2B fulfilment. Primarily, they support brands with high order volumes or complex tech requirements. Whether you're selling through your own website, marketplaces, retailers or wholesale channels, the platform is designed to support omnichannel growth. 

 Why do brands choose fulfilmentcrowd? 

 Brands choose fulfilmentcrowd for its combination of global fulfilment infrastructure, in-house technology and long-term scalability. By bringing fulfilment, inventory and sales channels into one platform, businesses can simplify operations and grow with confidence. 

 How does fulfilmentcrowd support businesses as they grow? 

 As businesses expand into new regions, sales channels and customer markets, fulfilmentcrowd provides the technology, warehouse network and operational support needed to scale efficiently. The same platform, processes and fulfilment standards are used across the global network, making growth simpler to manage. 

## Looking for your next fulfilment partner? 

One platform for every order, everywhere

fulfilmentcrowd Ltd, Western Avenue, Matrix Park, Chorley, PR7 7NB

fulfilmentcrowd strengthens leadership team for next phase of growth

Published

Published 24 April 2026

# fulfilmentcrowd strengthens leadership team for next phase of growth 

 As fulfilmentcrowd enters its next stage of growth, we’ve made a series of key leadership appointments designed to strengthen our global team and sharpen our focus on delivering long-term value. 

As fulfilmentcrowd enters its next stage of growth, we’ve made a series of key leadership appointments designed to strengthen our global team and sharpen our focus on delivering long-term value. 

Following investment from Palatine in 2025, these changes mark a natural step forward as we continue to scale across territories and continue to support ambitious omnichannel brands.

## A new Managing Director to lead the next chapter

Paul Taylor has been appointed Managing Director, stepping up from his previous role as Chief Operating Officer.

Joining fulfilmentcrowd in 2021, Paul has over 20 years of experience in logistics, supply chain, retail and eCommerce fulfilment, and has previously held senior roles at ASDA, DHL Supply Chain, Wincanton and the Cauldwell Group. Paul will lead a newly formed growth board, bringing together cross-functional expertise to drive key value creation initiatives across the business. His focus will be on ensuring we continue to scale in a way that’s both efficient and aligned with the needs of our clients.

 

Link title: Strengthening the board across key areas (this will not show on the frontend)

## Strengthening the board across key areas

Alongside Paul’s appointment, we’ve made a number of senior leadership moves across commercial, finance, marketing and sales.

Ben Chicken has been promoted to Director of Commercial, where he’ll lead a more data-led approach to decision-making across the business, helping us move faster and smarter as we grow.

Rachel Miller joins the board as Director of Finance, taking responsibility for financial risk management and corporate compliance. Her appointment reflects both our recent growth and the expansion of our global operations.

Katie Shepherd steps into the role of Director of Marketing, following her return to the business in 2024 and her work rebuilding the fulfilmentcrowd brand. She’ll continue to focus on strengthening how we show up in the market and support our customers.

Matthew Humphreys, Director of Sales, will lead our international new business acquisition strategy, helping to drive continued growth across new and existing markets.

These new appointments join our existing board members – Shaun Cummins (Director of Information Systems), Austin Waddecar (Director of Product) and Chris White (Director of Client Services) – further strengthening the leadership team across every area of the business. 

> This is a natural evolution of our leadership team as we focus on driving our next stage of growth. The strength of fulfilmentcrowd lies in its people, and these appointments reflect both the depth of talent within the business and the progress we’ve made over the past two years. I have every confidence that Paul and his team will continue to steer the business effectively as we scale across territories. 

 

Lee Thompson, CEO

## Looking ahead

With a strengthened leadership team in place, we're well positioned for the next phase of our journey – continuing to combine global fulfilment expertise with technology that makes complex operations simple.

As we grow, our focus remains the same: helping ambitious brands scale internationally with cost-effective fulfilment, fast delivery and a consistently great customer experience.

Visit our Meet the Team page to see our newly formed board setup in full.

 Written by Ryan Johnson 24 April 2026 

fulfilmentcrowd Ltd, Western Avenue, Matrix Park, Chorley, PR7 7NB
